# Misata Almanac

> An open, proof-backed knowledge base of real-world data rules and patterns for synthetic data generation: check-digit algorithms, identifier formats, tax rates, calendars, code lists, and distributions from official statistics, each cited to a primary source with a content hash and executable tests.

Every entry is a YAML file validated by schema/entry.schema.json. Read an entry's `spec` to execute the rule or sample the distribution, its `evidence` for the primary source, URL and SHA-256 of the fetched resource, `assumed` for anything derived rather than published, and `tests` for the statistics the verifier reproduces. Rules carry valid_from and valid_to; statistics carry observed_period. Ask which entries applied on a date with `almanac applies --on YYYY-MM-DD`.

- Repository: https://github.com/Misata-labs/almanac
- Manifest (JSON index of every entry): https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Misata-labs/almanac/main/manifest.json
- Schema: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Misata-labs/almanac/main/schema/entry.schema.json
- Catalogue: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Misata-labs/almanac/main/CATALOGUE.md
- Wanted entries and their official sources: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Misata-labs/almanac/main/WANTED.md
- Contributing and source policy: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Misata-labs/almanac/main/CONTRIBUTING.md

## calendar

- [gb-bank-holidays](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Misata-labs/almanac/main/entries/calendar/GB/gb-bank-holidays.yaml): United Kingdom bank holidays by nation, 2019 to 2028. rule, GB, tier A, verified, 2019-01-01 to 2028-12-31. Source: Government Digital Service (GOV.UK).
- [gb-clock-change](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Misata-labs/almanac/main/entries/calendar/GB/gb-clock-change.yaml): United Kingdom clock changes (British Summer Time), 2025 to 2028. rule, GB, tier A, verified, 2025-01-01 to 2028-12-31. Source: Government Digital Service (GOV.UK).

## company

- [gb-company-type-and-status-codes](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Misata-labs/almanac/main/entries/company/GB/gb-company-type-and-status-codes.yaml): United Kingdom Companies House company type and company status codes. rule, GB, tier A, license-review, 2026-09-11 to open. Source: Companies House.

- [gb-email-address-acceptance](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Misata-labs/almanac/main/entries/contact/GB/gb-email-address-acceptance.yaml): Email address acceptance pattern used by HM Revenue & Customs services. rule, GB, tier A, verified, 2024-09-27 to open. Source: HM Revenue & Customs.

## currency

- [global-ecb-euro-fx-reference-rates-monthly-2025](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Misata-labs/almanac/main/entries/currency/global/global-ecb-euro-fx-reference-rates-monthly-2025.yaml): ECB euro foreign exchange reference rates, monthly averages 2025 (USD, GBP, JPY, INR, BRL, CNY, CHF per EUR). temporal, global, tier A, verified, observed 2025-01-01 to 2025-12-31. Source: European Central Bank.
- [global-iso4217-currency-minor-units](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Misata-labs/almanac/main/entries/currency/global/global-iso4217-currency-minor-units.yaml): ISO 4217 current currency codes with numeric codes and minor units, list published 2026-09-17. rule, global, tier A, license-review, 2026-09-17 to open. Source: SIX Financial Information (ISO 4217 Maintenance Agency).

## identifiers

Source: Secretaria Especial da Receita Federal do Brasil; SERPRO (Serviço Federal de Processamento de Dados).
- [gb-nino-format](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Misata-labs/almanac/main/entries/identifiers/GB/gb-nino-format.yaml): United Kingdom National Insurance number (NINO) format. rule, GB, tier A, verified, 2025-08-11 to open. Source: HM Revenue & Customs.
- [gb-utr-check-digit](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Misata-labs/almanac/main/entries/identifiers/GB/gb-utr-check-digit.yaml): United Kingdom Unique Taxpayer Reference (UTR) modulus-11 check digit. rule, GB, tier A, verified, 2025-08-11 to open. Source: HM Revenue & Customs.
- [gb-vrn-check-digits](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Misata-labs/almanac/main/entries/identifiers/GB/gb-vrn-check-digits.yaml): United Kingdom VAT registration number (VRN) MOD 97 and MOD 9755 check digits. rule, GB, tier A, verified, 2025-08-11 to open. Source: HM Revenue & Customs.
